_comment: What each help topic is for, shown to the routing agent next to the topic name. Keys are topic names as people write them (case, spacing and a trailing slash do not matter). Topics not listed here use the notes kept in osTicket, if any. Drafted from the closed-ticket analysis: correct any that are wrong, add the ones missing.
SMS Alerts: Client not receiving SMS or e-mail transaction alerts, or alerts going to the wrong number.
SMS Alerts / Transactional: No SMS alerts for debits and credits on the account, or alerts going to the wrong number.
SMS Alerts / Salaries: No SMS alert when the client's salary is paid in.
Ecocash-Registration: Linking a client's NMB account to their EcoCash wallet fails (USSD, branch or iApprove).
Ecocash / Registration: Linking a client's NMB account to their EcoCash wallet fails.
Ecocash / Deregistration: Delinking an NMB account from an EcoCash wallet, or a delink that failed.
Ecocash / Multiple Subs: An EcoCash wallet or NMB account linked more than once, or to the wrong account.
Ecocash / Failed Transactions: EcoCash transaction that failed: money deducted but not received.
FAILED ECOCASH B2W / WB2: Failed EcoCash bank-to-wallet (B2W) or wallet-to-bank (W2B) transfer needing investigation or reversal.
Failed ZIPIT Transaction: Interbank ZIPIT transfer failed, or the money did not reach the other bank; reversal requests.
NMB Connect / Failed Transaction: A transfer or payment made in the NMB Connect app failed or did not complete.
NMB Connect / USSD / Failed Transactions: A USSD or app transfer or payment failed (RTGS, ZIPIT, internal transfer, ZIMRA, airtime, bills).
FAILED AIRTIME PURCHASE: Airtime or data bundle bought from the account but not received.
FAILED ZESA: ZESA electricity token paid for but not received.
Postilion: Card switch (Postilion) issues: ATM or POS card transactions failing, declined, or needing reversal.
Postilion transactions: A card, ATM, POS, ZIPIT, B2W/W2B or airtime transaction through the switch that failed or needs checking.
NMB Connect / Registration: Registering a client on NMB Connect (app or USSD), or a registration that failed.
NMB Connect / OTP: One-time password (OTP) not received, or OTP errors, on NMB Connect.
NMB Connect / Account: Accounts missing, not visible or shown wrongly in NMB Connect.
NMB Connect / System Issue: NMB Connect app faults: errors, crashes, downtime, a feature not working for many users.
NMB Connect / USSD / Registration: Registering a client on NMB Connect USSD, or a USSD registration that failed.
NMB Connect / USSD / OTP: OTP not received or rejected on NMB Connect USSD.
NMB Connect / USSD / Forgot Username: Client forgot their NMB Connect USSD username.
USSD / Account: Mobile USSD banking: account access or transactions through the USSD menu.
Internet Banking: Corporate or personal internet banking: access, transactions and approvals.
Internet Banking / OTP: OTP not received or rejected on internet banking.
Internet Banking / Forgot Username: Internet banking user forgot their username.
Internet Banking / RTGS Transaction: An internet banking RTGS payment failed, is stuck or needs checking.
Internet Banking / Internal Transfer: An internet banking transfer between NMB accounts failed or needs checking.
Internet Banking / Bill Payment: A bill payment through internet banking failed or needs checking.
Internet Banking / Salaries: Salary upload or salary batch through internet banking failed or needs checking.
Internet Banking / RTGS Bulk: A bulk RTGS batch through internet banking failed or needs checking.
Old Internet Banking: Issues with the legacy (old) internet banking platform.
HelpDesk / Login: A staff member cannot log in to a bank system: wrong credentials, locked profile, password reset.
HelpDesk / Logging Ticket: General helpdesk request; no more specific topic applies.
Cards and E-Banking: Debit card requests and issues (new card, blocked card, PIN) and e-banking channel queries.
Account Opening: New account opening requests, requirements and status.
Salaries: Bulk salary upload or salary processing queries.
Transporter / System issues: The internal Transporter file-transfer system (staff-facing, not client money movement).
T24 / Statements and EStatements: Account statements and e-statements from core banking.
T24 / Limits: Transaction or account limits in core banking.
T24 / Charges: Charges and fees debited by core banking.
T24 / Failing to post: A core banking posting fails at the branch.
ATM / System Issues: ATM faults affecting a machine or many clients (not a single client's failed withdrawal).
Maintenance Issues: Premises or equipment maintenance (aircon, generators, facilities).
Escalated to Vendor: Not a subject: records that the issue has been escalated to a third-party vendor.
